FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
f
NOTIFICATION
tmbhat, the 26h December, 2025
No. HCM/A-96/2023/Estt/ A7 g g+ : in view of the requests received from multiple
aspiring candidates seeking an extension of the submission deadline, it is hereby informed
to all concerned that the online registration and submission of application forms for direct
recruitment to the posts of System Assistant, advertised vide Advertisement of even
number dated 3rd November, 2025, sha:I be re-opened from 13.01.2026 (11:00 A.M.)
to 19.01.2026 (04:00 P.M.). Candidates who have already applied for the
aforementioned post(s) need not apply afresh.
It is further notified that Guwahati has been added as an additional Examination Centre
along with Imphal. Candidates who have already submitted their application forms and
wish to change their Examination Centre to Guwahati shall be provided a separate link
on the official website (www.hcmimphal.nic.in) for exercising the option. A separate
notification in this regard shall follow. Fresh applicants may select their preferred
Examination Centre at the time of submission of application forms.
The links for submission of the application form will be available only on the official
website, https://www.hcmimphal.nic.in on the date of reopening.
c/CPL g-V/
(KH. ArIT SfNGH)
i/c REGISTRAR GENERAL
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
